data.question: 我最近在工作上遇到了一些挑战，不知道应该如何应对。能给我一些指导吗？

hexagram.name: 渐卦
hexagram.title: 渐卦 - Development
hexagram.image_text: 山上有木，渐；君子以居贤德善俗。

focus_yao.yao_text: 六五：鸿渐于陵，妇三岁不孕，终莫之胜，吉。

insight.revelation: 成长和进步需要时间，如同树木在山上逐渐生长。
insight.analysis: 面对工作上的挑战，你正处于一个发展和逐步适应的过程中。
insight.guidance: 保持耐心，逐步积累你的能力和经验，稳步前进。
insight.encouragement: 每一步虽小，但都是通往成功的重要一步，坚持下去，你将看到成果。

deep_wisdom.title: Deep Wisdom
deep_wisdom.explanation: The Development hexagram symbolizes the gradual process of growth and maturation...
deep_wisdom.philosophical_meaning: True progress is not about quick success but about consistent development and perseverance.
deep_wisdom.personal_interpretation: Your current challenges are part of your journey to growth; embrace the process and trust in your ability to overcome them.

action_guide.title: Action Guide
main_actions: Identify small, achievable goals that contribute to your overall professional development
Seek mentorship or guidance from those who have faced similar challenges
supporting_actions: Engage in continuous learning to enhance your skills and knowledge
Practice patience and resilience in the face of setbacks
action_guide.inspirational_message: Progress may be slow, but every step forward is a step closer to your goals.

summary.title: Summary
action_guide: 设定可实现的小目标，助力职业发展
寻找导师或向有经验的人寻求指导
持续学习，增强技能和知识
面对挫折时保持耐心和韧性
